unit.why: Inside a homiletic section on 'weakness of spirit' (חלישות דעת), the author tells how R. Levi Yitzhak fell from his spiritual level in 5553 and recovered, and how he cast lots about his followers, with brief allusions to a rabbi near the big city and to the Besht.
unit.boundary_note: Part of an ongoing homiletic chapter 'מענין חלישות דעת' that begins in the previous division; the Besht allusion is truncated with וכו' and cites a source (א״ה בהק' ה״ה לס׳ במדבר).

stories.start_quote: וכמו שעשו להק׳ מופ״ה מוהר״ר לוי יצחק
stories.end_quote: ואמר לו רבי ומורי והחזיר לו
stories.summary_en: R. Levi Yitzhak was so humiliated in 5553 that he fell from his level, an event the Maggid of Kozienice explained as a heavenly accusation. A year later the author's father-in-law studied with him after his recovery and saw him cast lots on whether his followers were worthy. The passage adds brief examples of others brought down by weakness of spirit, including the Besht.

quotes: מרוב חלישות דעת הרבה נפל ממדריגתו
ע״י חלישות הדעת הרבה נפלו וירדו
tags.why: Dejection and humiliation that cause a spiritual fall are the theme.

quotes: שהיה מחלישין דעתו מאד אין שיעור
והיה מתפלל בתוך סידור קטן במהירות
tags.why: His degraded way of praying is described.
The Maggid's help could not prevent the fall, and the reason is explained.

quotes: שגם בשמים ממעל בשנה הזאת היה עליו קטרוג
tags.why: A heavenly accusation is invoked as the cause, though heaven is not an actual setting.

quotes: שהמגיד הק׳ מקאזניץ תלמידו עזרו הרבה
tags.why: Disciples help him and study with him.
The father-in-law stayed at the tsaddik's court for about a year.
Study with the tsaddik is depicted.

quotes: עד שנעשה כאש שורף להבת שלהבת
tags.why: The disciple becomes fiery in fervor.

quotes: וסיפר לי מו״ח ההצה״ק מה׳ אברהם מרדכי מפינטשוף
tags.why: The account is framed as told by the author's father-in-law, a named tsaddik.
A disciple stands before the Besht in awe.
The anecdotes serve as examples inside a homiletic discussion of חלישות דעת.
